描述_EN: objects such as this daoist bronze sculpture may have come from a temple or a tomb in china. the figure represents lu dongbin, one of the eight immortals, honoured as a great poet and swordsman and shown here wearing his scholar's cap and robes.
描述_ZN: 像这样的道教青铜雕塑可能来自中国的寺庙或坟墓。 这个人物代表了八仙之一的吕洞宾，他被誉为伟大的诗人和剑客，这里显示的是他的学者帽和长袍。
